name: Chapter IV
summary: Barnil Stonepot is searching for the ending of Hemet Nesingwary's hunting tale in Chapter IV. Three pages are missing from the jungle.

sections.title: The Grand Finale
sections.body: Barnil Stonepot calls the fourth chapter Hemet Nesingwary's grand finale. He needs you to find pages twenty-five, twenty-six, and twenty-seven. The three sheets lie scattered across the jungle. Without them, he cannot restore the tale's conclusion.

faq.answer: Barnil Stonepot wants you to gather the scattered pages so he can piece together the ending of Hemet Nesingwary's hunting book.

faq.q: Which pages are required to finish Chapter IV?
faq.answer: You need pages twenty-five, twenty-six, and twenty-seven of The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to finish the fourth chapter.
Barnil Stonepot first asked for the scattered leaves of The Green Hills of Stranglethorn. Now he seeks the pages that restore the ending.
